invocations.name: freeze_check
invocations.note: --restrict-to-registration is MANDATORY and is pinned here as argv rather than remembered; unrestricted the checker exits 3 on rows belonging to other campaigns

guards.name: age_guard
guards.condition: every field at endTime must have st_mtime NEWER than the case's own 0/T
guards.arming_value: completion_report(): age_pass is set False on any field not newer; 'age guard' is appended to failed_clauses whenever age_pass is not True
guards.note: 0/T is touched last at launch by the stage-4 wrapper, so it dates the run allowed to produce the answer.

guards.name: cell_count_source
guards.condition: n_cells_from_checkmesh() returns (None, reason) unless a 'cells: N' line is found in a checkMesh log; len(owner) is nFaces and is used nowhere

guards.name: planted_control_perturbation_arm
guards.condition: a written time directory carrying p must exist to plant into; without one the arm reports NOT DISCHARGEABLE rather than passing by default

guards.name: instrument_source_arm
guards.condition: SOURCE_DEFECT_RULES applied to the comparator's text: two-point plateau, cell count from owner, literal claim string, silent zero default
guards.arming_value: 4 rules; reported SEPARATELY from the perturbation arm because 'can see its input' and 'computes the right thing' are different claims

guards.name: clamp_not_firing
guards.condition: max(LimitedCells reported by the limitTemperature fvOption) <= max_clamped_cells
guards.note: a clamp active at the plateau is a boundary condition on the answer, not a stabiliser, and biases every gate downstream of it

guards.name: plateau_window
guards.condition: trailing-window plateau statistic declared before the run; NOT a difference between the last two writes (VERIFICATION_CHARTER 2bd)

arming_value.window: trailing 20 percent of writes (the last 10 of 50)
arming_value.statistic: max absolute deviation from the window mean, relative to the window mean

guards.name: registration_committed_before_compute
guards.condition: git cat-file -e HEAD:<registration_path> must succeed in stage 4 preflight; a refusal blocks the launch

guards.name: mesh_matches_birth_certificate
guards.condition: verify_birth() re-hashes every file in the level's mesh manifest; a MUTATED or UNCERTIFIED file refuses the launch
guards.arming_value: renumberMesh -overwrite is the documented way a certified mesh is rewritten in place on this box, and it happens silently

gates.name: GATE P
gates.metric: dCp at 7 span stations, x/c <= 0.90, M=0.8395

gates.name: GATE G
gates.metric: rule-5 Roache triple on {L2,L1,L0}, observed order + GCI at Fs=1.25
gates.band: CONVERGING required; NOT A RESULT otherwise

cost.cap_note: CASE_PROTOCOL_CHARTER section 1 requires a cap at three times the estimate, and it is registered here. Under Sanaa's 2026-09-10 exemption the cap DOES NOT STOP this run: section 4's 'cap reached: stop, NOT A RESULT, never a raised cap' is suspended for M6CP1 as a 3D demo case. The cap is registered so the overrun is MEASURABLE, not so it is enforceable. NOTE ALSO that the runner's cap enforcement (D539) is advisory and OFF, so a silent runner is not evidence a cap was respected -- a cap never enforced and a cap never exceeded look identical in the log.
cost.cost_basis: core-minutes = wall s x ranks / 60, counted over EVERY solve under the run root with ranks from each log's OWN banner. Dollars DERIVED at $0.0513/core-h, reported-by-owner, NOT measured.
cost.routing: CPU on this box, detached under the runner daemon, PPID 1

blockage.note: blockage = model frontal area / domain cross-section.  Stated because a farfield that is merely 'far' is a claim, not a number.
